question_binding.exact_text: How should successor design conflicts be adjudicated without granting prior authority to legacy contracts, preserved designs, user directions, code evidence, cognitive theory, reviewers, agents or majority agreement; and which results may become constitution clauses?

materiality_profile.rationale: The method can shape safety, cognition, migration, public Interfaces and later irreversible decisions; use HIGH until a new exact question generation proves a narrower scope.

STATUS_QUO_INFORMED_HOLISTIC_JUDGMENT.strongest_fair_claim: For novel, poorly measured and tightly coupled architecture choices, informed holistic judgment can preserve context and tacit expertise better than premature formalization, while reaching a timely and revisable decision.
legitimate_strengths: Retains qualitative context, tacit knowledge and interactions that an incomplete metric model may omit.
Has low process overhead and can respond quickly when evidence is sparse or the decision is reversible.
Can adapt the depth of analysis to the materiality and uncertainty of the decision.
hard_failure_risks: A plausible narrative can conceal a missing candidate, unsupported assumption or unresolved hard constraint.
The producer can become its own oracle when no detached falsification or verification path exists.
Chronology, confidence or status can silently substitute for claim-specific evidence.
allowed_auxiliary_roles: Expert synthesis after candidate-specific evidence and constraints have been made inspectable.
Rapid triage for low-impact reversible questions with explicit reopening triggers.
Generation of hypotheses, scenarios and candidate mechanisms for subsequent testing.
falsification_conditions: Independent reconstruction repeatedly finds material omitted candidates, constraints or counter-evidence.
Equivalent decision makers given the same frozen inputs reach incompatible outcomes without an identifiable value choice.
The method cannot distinguish an empirical disagreement from a product-value or authorization disagreement.
STATUS_QUO_INFORMED_HOLISTIC_JUDGMENT.decision_process: A responsible designer or small expert group integrates available facts, constraints, experience and context into a documented holistic judgment without a mandatory formal aggregation algorithm.
known_limitations: Reasoning, candidate coverage and tradeoff treatment may be difficult for an independent party to reconstruct.
Calibration depends strongly on the expertise, incentives and cognitive limits of the decision maker.
Unstated values and authority assumptions can be mistaken for empirical conclusions.

AUTHORITY_HIERARCHY.strongest_fair_claim: A transparent authority hierarchy provides fast, accountable and unambiguous resolution where legitimate owners must set values, risk tolerance or operational permissions and where indecision itself is costly.
legitimate_strengths: Makes accountability and escalation paths explicit.
Fits genuine product-value, safety-risk-acceptance and operational-authorization decisions that require an accountable owner.
Avoids deadlock and can provide deterministic resolution under time pressure.
hard_failure_risks: Organizational rank can override refuting evidence or a non-compensable safety constraint.
One authority class can impersonate another, such as product ownership being treated as verification evidence.
Ambiguous scope or stale delegation can create apparently authorized but invalid decisions.
allowed_auxiliary_roles: Assign legitimate owners for product values, safety acceptance and exact operational authorization.
Resolve process escalation and resource-allocation questions without deciding empirical claims.
Authenticate who may accept a disclosed residual risk or choose among genuine value-equivalent options.
falsification_conditions: The hierarchy produces different truth judgments for identical evidence solely because the claimant identity changes.
An authority decision cannot expose which part is value choice, constraint acceptance, empirical finding or execution permission.
Scope, delegation, authentication or expiration cannot be independently verified for a material decision.
AUTHORITY_HIERARCHY.decision_process: Claims or decisions are resolved by a predeclared hierarchy of accountable authorities, with lower levels deferring to the highest applicable authority and escalating unresolved scope conflicts.
known_limitations: Authority over a decision does not establish empirical truth or architecture correctness.
A single hierarchy may not fit claims with different legitimate owners and scopes.
The quality of the result depends on information reaching the authority without distortion.

MULTI_CRITERIA_SCALAR_AGGREGATION.strongest_fair_claim: When objectives, measurements and preference tradeoffs are sufficiently specified, scalar multi-criteria aggregation makes reasoning reproducible, exposes sensitivity and enables disciplined comparison across many heterogeneous alternatives.
legitimate_strengths: Forces explicit objectives, criteria, measurements and preference weights.
Supports repeatable ranking, sensitivity analysis and comparison of many alternatives.
Makes compensatory tradeoffs visible when compensation is legitimately allowed.
hard_failure_risks: A severe safety, capability or evidence gap can be compensated by unrelated advantages.
UNKNOWN or contested measurements can be converted into neutral numbers and produce a false winner.
Candidate, criterion or weight choices can be tuned after observing results.
allowed_auxiliary_roles: Sensitivity analysis within a set that has already passed all applicable hard constraints.
Elicitation and documentation of product-value preferences and objective tradeoffs.
Prioritization of research, prototype or implementation work where the score is not treated as truth or authorization.
falsification_conditions: Reasonable normalization, weighting or uncertainty choices reverse the selected alternative.
The scalar ordering changes when an irrelevant or dominated alternative is added or removed.
A candidate with a blocking unknown or non-compensable constraint failure can outrank an admissible candidate.
MULTI_CRITERIA_SCALAR_AGGREGATION.decision_process: Alternatives are evaluated on explicit criteria, normalized and combined through declared weights or utility functions into a scalar ordering, with uncertainty and sensitivity analysis around inputs and preferences.
known_limitations: Normalization and weights encode value judgments and model assumptions.
A single scalar can obscure Pareto structure, uncertainty, incomparability and non-compensable constraints.
Results can be unstable when evidence is sparse, correlated or measured on ill-defined scales.

DELIBERATIVE_COMMITTEE.strongest_fair_claim: Structured deliberation among independent perspectives can reveal blind spots, integrate distributed expertise and earn legitimate commitment for complex socio-technical decisions that no single analyst can fully model.
legitimate_strengths: Combines domain, operations, safety, user and architecture perspectives.
Adversarial discussion can expose hidden assumptions and shared-source dependencies.
A reasoned consensus process can improve implementation commitment and surface residual dissent.
hard_failure_risks: Vote count or apparent consensus can be mistaken for empirical proof.
Minority safety findings or disconfirming evidence can be suppressed by convergence pressure.
Unclear membership and decision rights can blur product values, verification and authorization.
allowed_auxiliary_roles: Independent challenge and multidisciplinary scenario discovery.
Merge distinct findings, counterarguments and evidence without treating reviewers as votes.
Deliberate genuine product-value choices after empirical and safety boundaries are explicit.
falsification_conditions: Outcome tracks reviewer count, status or coalition membership more strongly than disclosed evidence and constraints.
Independent dissent, counter-evidence or shared dependency clusters cannot remain visible in the final record.
Changing committee composition reverses empirical findings without any change to the frozen evidence.
DELIBERATIVE_COMMITTEE.decision_process: A diverse, conflict-disclosing committee examines competing proposals and evidence, challenges assumptions and seeks reasoned consensus or an explicit recorded disagreement rather than relying on one producer.
known_limitations: Consensus may reflect social dynamics, incentives, status or fatigue rather than evidence quality.
Shared upstream assumptions can make nominally diverse reviewers dependent.
Deliberation cost and latency grow with group size, ambiguity and decision scope.

CONSTRAINT_FIRST_TYPED_EVIDENCE.strongest_fair_claim: For high-impact successor design, a constraint-first typed-evidence method can prevent authority, values, evidence and authorization from impersonating one another while preserving uncertainty, falsifiability and non-compensable obligations more faithfully than a forced hierarchy, vote or scalar score.
legitimate_strengths: Separates empirical support, product values, safety admissibility, architecture validation and operational authorization.
Keeps blocking unknowns and incomparability visible instead of forcing a winner.
Supports exact denominators, counter-evidence, falsification, independent challenge and detached activation.
hard_failure_risks: The method producer can design self-serving constraints or candidate representations and then pass its own test.
A large schema and artifact graph can export complexity without improving decision quality.
Overclassification can delay useful prototypes or disguise ordinary judgment as mechanical certainty.
allowed_auxiliary_roles: Use informed expert judgment to generate claims, candidates and interpretations, with assumptions visible.
Use scalar aggregation only for legitimate compensatory preferences inside the feasible set.
Use deliberative review to merge evidence and findings, and authority only for genuine value or authorization decisions.
falsification_conditions: Independent challengers cannot reproduce claim classification, constraint ownership or the non-dominated set from frozen inputs.
The method reaches a forced outcome when a material hard constraint, evidence dependency, unknown or genuine value choice remains unresolved.
For comparable decisions, the additional artifacts and interfaces do not measurably improve error detection, reversibility or decision traceability over a simpler method.
CONSTRAINT_FIRST_TYPED_EVIDENCE.decision_process: Classify each claim by legitimate standing, freeze a strongest-fair candidate and evidence denominator, eliminate hard-constraint failures or blocking unknowns, compare the remaining Pareto set with discriminating tests, and keep design disposition separate from activation authorization.
known_limitations: Requires careful claim typing, denominator construction and evidence maintenance.
Can impose disproportionate process cost on low-impact or easily reversible decisions.
Hard-constraint definitions and typed-standing boundaries can themselves be incomplete or contested.

closure_rule.bounded_question: Select or revise a design-adjudication method for the cognitive successor while keeping empirical support, product values, safety constraints, architecture validation and operational authorization distinguishable.
closure_rule.included_method_families: The five keyed candidates are the strongest-fair representatives found for informal expert synthesis, authority ordering, scalar multi-criteria aggregation, deliberative collective judgment and constraint-first typed evidence.
closure_rule.saturation_rule: Saturation is reached only for this bounded question when an additional discovered method is either mechanism-equivalent to a keyed candidate, usable solely as an auxiliary technique, or introduces no distinct way to determine admissibility and resolve remaining tradeoffs.
reopening_conditions: A discovered method has a materially distinct admissibility or tradeoff-resolution mechanism that cannot be represented by any keyed candidate or its allowed auxiliary roles.
New supporting or refuting evidence materially changes a strongest-fair candidate, limitation, hard-failure risk or falsification condition.
The bounded question, claim-kind scope, legitimate owners or applicable non-compensable constraints change.
Independent challenge demonstrates that any keyed candidate is a strawman, asymmetric, internally inconsistent or missing a material variant.
A falsification condition is observed for the denominator construction or saturation claim.
